Question
========
What is Wheelan’s primary message of Chapter 1 (“What’s the Point?”) in
*Naked Statistics: Stripping the Dread from the Data?*

Answerlist
----------

* Statistics simplify complex information to help us make better
    decisions
    
* Statistics explain why relationship exist between variables

* Statistical formulas are the most important part of understanding
    data
    
* Statistics provide honest answers to complex questions
